observations: Three photos show stacks of used tires in a covered outdoor shop
Tires are stacked vertically in columns and some lie flat in the foreground
No readable brand or model names are visible on any tire sidewall
Some tires have chalk or yellow markings on them
Foreground tires show inner liners but tread depth cannot be measured from the images
Seller watermark "IKWE ANTHONY" appears across the photos

claims.evidence: photos show stacked tires only, no distributor signage or origin documents
no tread depth measurement visible in any photo
external bulges are not ruled out from the limited angles shown
no vehicle documents or removal records are shown

risks.risk: Tread depth is lower than claimed
risks.proof: close-up photo of tread with depth gauge or coin
clear photo of sidewall showing width, profile, and rim diameter
risks.if_unproven: as unknown size at lowest market value

risks.proof: photo of DOT manufacture date code
risks.if_unproven: as aged rubber with reduced safe life

risks.proof: video or photos showing inside of each tire

proof_requests: Sidewall photo showing tire size (e.g., 205/55 R16)
Tread close-up with depth gauge or coin
Interior inspection video or photos for patches and bulges
response.reason: The photos show used car tires, which can be priced at worst case as unknown-size, unverified-condition tires; proof of size, tread, age, and interior condition would raise the value.
